description: A user uploads a photo from the phone app. In order, which background stages run for that photo until it can be found by natural-language search, has been grouped under people, and has been compared with near-duplicates, and what causes each stage to start? Give the function that starts each next stage.
anchor_note: non-bug task: root_cause_symbols holds the anchor (entry point / changed symbol); RC metrics are reported for category A only
alternatives: External-library assets enter the same chain via LibraryService.queuePostSyncJobs -> SidecarCheck -> JobService.onDone -> AssetExtractMetadata (library.service.ts, job.service.ts); an acceptable answer may mention it but the upload path is the asked one.
Video assets additionally get AssetEncodeVideo queued at step 7 (MediaService.handleVideoConversion).

source.verification: Vitest (not run here): server/src/services/job.service.spec.ts, tests 'should queue 3 jobs when a AssetGenerateThumbnails job finishes successfully' and 'should queue 4 jobs when a AssetGenerateThumbnails job finishes successfully'. Those cover step 5/7 only. The SmartSearch->AssetDetectDuplicates link (job.service.ts:249-253) and the storage-template step are NOT covered by a test (spec case for SmartSearch at job.service.spec.ts:~108 passes no source). Remaining links verified by reading only.
source.notes: Edge semantics in gt_path: edge = how this step is reached from the previous one. Steps 11-13 are parallel branches, not sequential. Stage order inside step 7 is not guaranteed (three different queues). Confounder: facial recognition is enqueued by the face-detection handler, not by JobService.onDone.

evidence: server/src/services/asset-media.service.ts:202 queue AssetExtractMetadata source upload; :208 emit AssetCreate

server/src/services/job.service.ts:117-121 StorageTemplateMigrationSingle -> AssetGenerateThumbnails; :165-186 -> SmartSearch, AssetDetectFaces, Ocr (+AssetEncodeVideo); :249-253 SmartSearch -> AssetDetectDuplicates

notes: Every step verified: uploadAsset queues AssetExtractMetadata (asset-media.service.ts:202) -> handleMetadataExtraction emits AssetMetadataExtracted (metadata.service.ts:413) -> StorageTemplateService.onAssetMetadataExtracted queues StorageTemplateMigrationSingle (storage-template.service.ts:138-141) -> JobService.onDone queues AssetGenerateThumbnails (job.service.ts:117-121) -> onDone queues SmartSearch/AssetDetectFaces/Ocr (:176-186) -> onDone after SmartSearch queues AssetDetectDuplicates (:249-253); handleDetectFaces queues FacialRecognition (person.service.ts:451-452).
OCR (OcrService.handleOcr) is on the chain but the question asks only for search, people and near-duplicates; treat as optional/extra in gt_path.
Face detection and smart search run in parallel after thumbnails; the draft gt_path lists them sequentially - scorers should not require this order between them.
